title: Refund Queue Boss Fight
oneLiner: A playful travel-support simulator that turns airline refund escalation into a timed evidence-stacking boss fight.
theme: Consumer rights / refund escalation as game

sourceSignals.title: Travelers still struggle with cancelled-flight refund evidence and escalation scripts
Meccha Chameleon proves cheap hide/fool/clip party loops can explode when the rule is instant
sourceSignals.source: Windows Central / PC Gamer / GamesRadar, June-July 2026

stitchPrompt: Create a playful consumer-rights game prototype called “Refund Queue Boss Fight.” Show a cancelled-trip case card, evidence cards, a boss meter for generic support replies, deadline timer, escalation move selector, and victory receipt with next steps. Design direction: use the playful-experimental profile with energetic contrast, readable game UI, one clear workflow, and humorous labels that do not hide the practical escalation path.
